training_qualification: one continuous session; distinct broadcast counted once per user
target: five most frequent distinct qualifying broadcasts by programme ID
target_tie: count descending, integer programme ID ascending
target_tie_sensitivity: count descending, integer programme ID descending
personal_tie: qualifying count descending, last qualifying overlap end descending, integer programme ID ascending
fallback: distinct historical users with a >=80% continuous-session watch; target-window candidates; ID ascending ties
